title: Tales of Sorrow: Strawsbrough Town
description:
Play the exciting hidden object adventurer "Tales of Sorrow: Strawsbrough Town". The young couple Melissa and Alfred celebrate their first wedding anniversary when Melissa puts a mysterious ring on her finger and falls into a magical sleep. Help Alfred find a cure and break the ring's curse!



- Immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of the small town of Strawsbrough

- Solve challenging hidden object puzzles and mini games

- Learn powerful spells and the secrets of alchemy

- Experience the gripping story and solve the mystery of the Ring
description_short: Play the exciting hidden object adventure "Tales of Sorrow: Strawsbrough Town" and help Alfred save his fiancée Melissa from a curse.
